name: Cursor
tagline: AI-first code editor built on VS Code with inline completions and chat
verdictSummary: You can install Continue.dev or Cody as a VS Code extension and get AI code completion in minutes. But Cursor's magic is deep IDE integration — inline diffs, whole-repo context, apply-in-editor, and custom models trained on editing behavior. Forking VS Code and adding AI is a team-scale effort, not a one-shot.
coreLoopDIY: VS Code extension with chat panel calling an LLM API
whatYouLose: Inline diff apply and accept/reject UX
Full codebase indexing (RAG over entire repo)
whyPeopleStillPay: AI completions that understand entire codebases and apply edits inline — way faster than copy-pasting from a chat window
